About

I’m Kartik Upadhyay, a Computer Science Engineering undergraduate at Birla Institute of Applied Sciences, Bhimtal, graduating in 2027 with a CGPA of 7.64. I work at the intersection of AI Engineering and Full-Stack Systems.

As an AI Engineer Intern, I’ve integrated LLM-powered chatbots into a live e-commerce platform, engineering prompts and a knowledge base for context-aware customer responses across 4+ service categories and 30+ delivery locations.

I build with Node.js, Express.js, React.js, and MongoDB, and use ChatGPT, Gemini, and Claude for content generation, FAQ automation, and e-commerce workflows. I also write automated API tests with Cypress and care about clean validation and reliable delivery.
